pages.transcription:
Wyndham Hotel				Newyork, 29.4.41

Dear Hanna & Manfred,

Just a line to tell you that there will be
a dinner of the P.E.N. Club on the 15th of May where
Stefan, Sigrid Undset, Romains and Somerset Maugham
will speak. The speeches will be relayed by WRUL
Boston to Europe. and maybe if this letter reaches you in
time you can find out and listen.
Thanks for your cable the other day which shows
that you feel now reassured about Eva's surroundings
and her happiness there. Last Sunday, as I wrote you already
I met her at Elizabeth's house, and next week I hope
I shall be able to go and visit her at Amity Hall. It
must be lovely there now, and now the children surely
enjoy the garden very much. If I go I shall try to
borrow a camera and send you some photos of the house
and people in it. But first of all I am impatient to
hear from you that Eva's photos have arrived, I am
quite sure you will like them. They are natural (mother
will say that the hair could be done better, but you
know how it is sometimes with hair, it just went the other
way and even the hair-dresser could not make it behave)
and say and from the one with the coat on - which Eva
disliked because she is ashamed of having had to wear
such a hat - you can see that she has grown.
I hope you had a good time at Bath on
Easter and did not return to London too quickly.
By the way, could Lore remain in Bath? Eva and I
have been wondering how you spent your Easter days and
what the garden looks like and whether the cuckoo is back
already. I do wish we would spend the next Easter again
together. From us not much is to report. Stefan is working,
I have finished the allergy test, am supposed to react to dust
and own bacterias and the injections with this stuff are being
prepared. I am fairly well, but hope for definite results
of these injections.

I expect a letter from you these days - a clipper arrived to-day - and
shall then write more in detail.
Love, kisses, all good wishes,
Lotte.
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief auf einem Blatt, beidseitig beschrieben (wobei die Rückseite leer ist, siehe Scan 2). Der Text am linken Rand wurde nachträglich vertikal hinzugefügt. Die Tinte ist violett.
Farbskala/Grauskala fuer Archivierung. Überlagert den Text des Briefes.
